request.spec:
Show on each person their settled-total (the due of their SETTLED claims that count, at
their frozen figures, corrections included) and their open-total (the due of their OPEN and
PENDING claims that count: a held, deferred or retired-and-excluded claim is left out as it is
from the due-total). Show the sheet's settled-total and open-total too, each simply everyone's
figure added up (not trimmed). The two must add up to the person's untrimmed due-total before the
cap.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Show on each person their settled-total (the due of their SETTLED claims that count, at
their frozen figures, corrections included) and their open-total (the due of their OPEN and
PENDING claims that count: a held, deferred or retired-and-excluded claim is left out as it is
from the due-total). Show the sheet's settled-total and open-total too, each simply everyone's
figure added up (not trimmed). The two must add up to the person's untrimmed due-total before the
cap.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Each person now shows a settled-total and an open-total, and the sheet shows the two added up across everyone. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec.

The whole change is in `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people.ts`. The page already works out every claim's due in the browser, so no server, database or audit changes were needed.

- **Per person:** two new columns, "Settled" (`person-settled-total`) and "Open" (`person-open-total`), sit next to "Due". They only include claims that already count toward the due-total, so a held, deferred or retired-and-excluded claim is left out of both, the same way it is left out of the due-total. Each claim's due is worked out the same way as for the due-total, so settled claims keep their frozen figures and corrections are included. Settled claims add to the settled-total; open and PENDING claims add to the open-total. The two add up to the person's due-total before the cap.
- **Sheet:** a new line next to "Due in total" shows `rollup-settled-total` and `rollup-open-total`. Each is a plain sum over everyone, without dropping the highest and lowest person's figure the way the sheet's due-total does.

If no rate applies to a person and their due-total shows "n/a", their claims count as 0 in these two totals, so the person shows 0.00 in each rather than "n/a".
